item.title: Police goes after former judge’s murderer in Anambra - TheGuildNG
item.description: The Nigerian Police has commenced a manhunt for the suspected murderer of Justice Ifeoma Okogwo (Rtd) after recovering the body from his residence in Asaba, Delta State. Of the two suspected murderers, Policemen attached to the Delta Police Command have arrested one, Lucky Matthew, while the manhunt for the principal suspect, Godwin Vanem, has been intensified.
